panels.caption: TAVI, All Tickets in Countdown Mode (3): Overdue, No Due Date, Due in 1 hour, Due today (and Due tomorrow, Due later off-screen) all show "Couldn’t load these tickets" (1). The page shows "At most 25 filter conditions are allowed" (2). Only On Hold loads.
Zoho Desk help: Countdown Mode lists tickets in up to seven columns by due time (1, 3). From the help article; not seen live.

rows: Each column lists the tickets that fall in it (Overdue, Due in 1 hour, Due today, …).
6 of 7 columns show "Couldn’t load these tickets" with Retry; Retry fails the same way. Only On Hold loads.
"At most 25 filter conditions are allowed." Each column asks the server for more than 25 conditions and the server refuses it.
Up to seven columns in Countdown Mode.
The mode exists with 7 columns (Overdue, No Due Date, Due in 1 hour, Due today, Due tomorrow, Due later, On Hold).
